mapper.insert: insert into match_tbl(creatorId, title, createAt, startTime, status, location, url, people, kategorie, anonymousCondi, genderCondi, chatCode) values(#{creatorId},#{title},#{createAt},#{startTime},#{status},#{location},#{url},#{people}, #{kategorie},#{anonymousCondi},#{genderCondi},#{chatCode});
insert into chat_tbl(type, hostId, chatTitle) values(#{type},#{hostId},#{chatTitle});
mapper.select: SELECT m.matchId AS matchId, startTime, title, people, status, COUNT(mp.matchId) AS countPeople, t.tag, kategorie FROM match_tbl m INNER JOIN matchparticipant_tbl mp ON m.matchId = mp.matchId LEFT JOIN matchtag_tbl t ON m.matchId = t.matchId WHERE status != 3 GROUP BY m.matchId, startTime, title, people, status, tag, kategorie;
mapper.delete: delete from bookmark_tbl where userId=#{userId} and matchId=#{matchId}
mapper.select: select matchId from bookmark_tbl where userId=#{userId}

select anonymousCondi, genderCondi, chatCode, userId, nickName, gender, location, startTime, title,people, (SELECT count(*) from matchparticipant_tbl where matchId = #{matchId}) as countPeople, status, kategorie from bb.match_tbl m join bb.user_tbl u on m.creatorId = u.userId where matchId = #{matchId};
SELECT tag from matchtag_tbl where matchId = #{matchId};
mapper.update: update match_tbl set status = #{status} where matchId = #{matchId}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) from matchparticipant_tbl where participantId = #{userId} and matchId = #{matchId};
mapper.delete: delete from matchparticipant_tbl where matchId = #{matchId} and participantId = #{userId}
delete from chatparticipant_tbl where chatCode = #{chatCode} and userId = #{userId}
